messages:
Elaine Park: FYI — Aurora SI flagged an architecture blocker for ACME Health deployment. They need final hardware SKU mapping + confirmation on marketplace image timing.
Raj Patel: what's the blocker specifically? network, certs, or GPU type?
Elaine Park: GPU/placement. Customer wants 96GB GPU nodes in their VPC and the SI expects our marketplace AMI to include the private helm bundle. Aurora says they can't proceed with validation until both are confirmed.
Simon K.: tagging @Maria since this touches the private deployment packaging and marketplace cadence. Maria?
Maria Gomez: saw this in the handoff doc. Two parts: 1) HW SKU: we support A100-80GB and H100 variants; 96GB is nonstandard — is Aurora asking for pooled memory nodes or single-card 96GB?
Kyle Lin: Aurora supplied a screenshot — their infra team expects a single 96GB instance (we don't publish that SKU). They can do multi-GPU but SI wants a single-card profile for scheduling simplicity.
Raj Patel: if customer insists on single 96GB, we should offer recommended alternative: H100x2 on private with nvlink or a dedicated Dedicated cluster. Need to confirm perf SLOs.
Maria Gomez: marketplace image timeline: current AMI with private helm is queued for next release (two weeks). If Aurora needs earlier, we can push a hotfix image but need approvals from security + release.
Simon K.: what's the minimum to unblock the SI validation? Is it ok if we provide a compatibility note and a provisional AMI, or do they require the GA marketplace listing?
Aurora-SI-Bot: @Aurora-SI-Bot automated note — Aurora SI requested "arch signoff" and scheduled a validation window for 2025-06-15.
Elaine Park: they need arch signoff before 06-09 to prep test cluster. A provisional AMI + clear note that 96GB single-card isn't supported but here's multi-GPU config might be acceptable.
Maria Gomez: okay I can draft the provisional AMI and a compat doc today if eng signs off on kernel/driver combo. Need the approved driver bundle: CUDA 12.1 + cuFFT matching.
Raj Patel: I'll validate driver combo and run a quick smoke on H100x2 profile. ETA end of day.
Kyle Lin: SI escalation: Aurora asked for runbook entries for failover between dedicated and hosted models. Do we have those ready?
Maria Gomez: we have a basic runbook but not the dedicated->hosted fallback steps with token/key rotation. I'll add a section and link to ops playbook.
Simon K.: also considering joint announcement cadence — Aurora wants references that deployment was done via marketplace. If we do provisional AMI only, legal/comms may need different wording. Heads-up for marketing.
Elaine Park: agreed. For now action items: (1) Raj to validate driver/kernel on H100x2 (2) Maria to produce provisional AMI + compat doc + runbook edits (3) Simon to sync with comms/legal if marketplace GA slips.
Raj Patel: started validation. I'll post results here.
Maria Gomez: drafting docs now, will ping when ready for review.
Simon K.: pinging @MarCom and @Legal for heads-up, I'll follow up via calendar. :calendar:
Elaine Park: thanks team — if we can get signoff by EOD tomorrow we still hit Aurora window.
Aurora-SI-Bot: Aurora SI updated validation status: waiting on "provisional AMI link".
Raj Patel: smoke tests passed on H100x2 with our runtime, latency within SLO for typical prompt sizes. Posting logs: ```
# smoke summary
model: stable-13b
hw: h100x2
p95: 210ms
errors: 0
```
Maria Gomez: provisional AMI upload link: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/ami/aurora-provisional-20250605 ; doc PR: https://git.redwood.ai/si/aurora/compare/ami-compat
Elaine Park: moving to close — Simon will update Aurora and comms. thanks all :thumbsup:
